name: message
title: Message
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Message (conversation): square avatar frame, speaker name in lettering, time in a small monospace. Pair with Bubble.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/message". It wraps your own components/ui/message, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A line of a conversation: avatar, name, bubbles.
meta.usage:
import { Message, MessageAvatar, MessageContent, MessageHeader } from "@/components/ui/manga/message"

<Message>
  <MessageAvatar>NO</MessageAvatar>
  <MessageContent>
    <MessageHeader>Night owl</MessageHeader>
    {/* Bubble… */}
  </MessageContent>
</Message>

props.name: data-manga
props.description: Set on the root line: the hook to style every message of the page from CSS.
